HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In which faith is the Rijubalika river important? (1 mark)
   A. Christianity
   B. Islam
   C. Jainism
   D. Sikhism

2. Which tree is also called the peepal? (1 mark)
   A. Ber tree
   B. Tulsi
   C. Bodhi tree
   D. Sal tree

3. What is Ganga jal? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A book
   C. Water from the River Ganga
   D. A kind of tree

4. Which plant is the holy basil? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi
   B. Peepal
   C. Beri
   D. Sal

5. How can water be used in worship? (1 mark)
   A. To build the temple roof
   B. To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   C. To make bells ring
   D. To burn incense

6. Which of these is one of Parshvanath's four rules? (1 mark)
   A. Satya, always speak the truth
   B. Wealth at any cost
   C. Be proud
   D. Take what you like

7. What did Siddhartha do for the wounded swan? (1 mark)
   A. He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   B. He shot it again
   C. He ignored it
   D. He took it away to eat

8. What did the wise men say about the swan? (1 mark)
   A. The one who shoots it owns it
   B. It belongs to the king
   C. It should be sold
   D. The one who saves a life has more right to it

9. What do the words nar and simha mean in Narsimha? (1 mark)
   A. Sun and moon
   B. Water and fire
   C. Man and lion
   D. King and queen

10. Which teaching is linked with Guru Ram Das Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. War
   C. Equality and serving others
   D. Wealth only

11. Where was Hiranyakashipu when Narsimha stopped him? (1 mark)
   A. In a field
   B. At the doorway, neither inside nor outside
   C. On a mountain
   D. On a boat

12. When can Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva be said? (1 mark)
   A. Only at a wedding
   B. Before meals and in the evening
   C. Only at a funeral
   D. Never

13. What does the veena stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Music and the arts
   C. War
   D. Rain

14. How can children with speech difficulties join prayers at assembly? (1 mark)
   A. By humming or listening
   B. By shouting
   C. They must not attend
   D. By leaving

15. Which is a typical feature of Mandirs? (1 mark)
   A. A roaring engine
   B. A bell rung gently on arrival
   C. A kitchen garden
   D. A water tank

16. What should you do before taking photographs in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Take at once
   B. Photograph the murti closely
   C. Use flash
   D. Ask permission

17. Which is safe behaviour in a matatu? (1 mark)
   A. Distracting the driver
   B. Putting the head out of the window
   C. Standing in the aisle
   D. Wearing the seat belt

18. The shopkeeper gives you Ksh 100 in change but you should get Ksh 70. What is the extra amount? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 30
   B. Ksh 70
   C. Ksh 170
   D. Ksh 100

19. What did the Buddha say about a person's words? (1 mark)
   A. They should be rude
   B. They should be false
   C. They should be true, kind and helpful
   D. They should be loud

20. What should Amina do about the extra money? (1 mark)
   A. Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   B. Keep it
   C. Give it away
   D. Spend it

21. In Kapaal Bhaati, which part of the breath is quick? (1 mark)
   A. Both are held
   B. The breath in
   C. Neither
   D. The breath out

22. How do we breathe in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Only through the mouth quickly
   B. Not at all
   C. Through the nose, slowly
   D. In gasps

23. Which is a benefit of yoga? (1 mark)
   A. It stops rain
   B. It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   C. It makes us noisy
   D. It gives instant riches

24. Why should Kapaal Bhaati and Bhastrika be done gently by children? (1 mark)
   A. They are active and need care
   B. They cannot be done
   C. They are very slow
   D. They are painful always

25. What does atma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Soul
   B. Fire
   C. Body
   D. Water

26. To what does the Bhagavad Gita compare the soul in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A tree
   C. A person who changes old clothes for new
   D. A stone

27. Every living being has what, according to Hindu belief? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A scripture
   C. A temple
   D. An atma, a small part of the divine

28. Which Purushartha is about doing our duty and living rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Dharma
   B. Kama
   C. Moksha
   D. Artha

29. What does Prarthana mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Prayer
   C. Rebirth
   D. Duty

30. Maha Shivratri means what? (1 mark)
   A. The great day of the Sun
   B. The festival of lights
   C. The great night of Shiva
   D. The day of forgiveness

31. Which national symbol is raised at Madaraka Day ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. A sail
   B. The school flag
   C. A flag of a sports team
   D. The national flag

32. In which month of the Indian traditional calendar is Maha Shivratri celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. Bhadrapada
   B. Chaitra
   C. Kartika
   D. Phalguna

33. Which prayer is chanted on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Om Namah Shivaya
   B. Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu
   C. Micchami Dukkadam
   D. Ik Onkar

34. What does Maha Shivratri teach? (1 mark)
   A. Getting rich
   B. Winning arguments
   C. Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   D. Playing games all night

35. What does graha mean in this tradition? (1 mark)
   A. A heavenly body
   B. A festival
   C. A house
   D. A river

36. What is the Indian name for Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. Guruvaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Shukravaar
   D. Shanivaar

37. Which is a memory trick for the seven names? (1 mark)
   A. Reading backwards only
   B. Writing them once
   C. Making a rhyme or song
   D. Skipping them

38. Which planet is called the red planet? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. Jupiter
   C. Venus
   D. Mars

39. The Indian traditional calendar is based on what? (1 mark)
   A. The school year
   B. Only the rain
   C. The Moon and the Sun
   D. Only the stars of the south

40. Som is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. Jupiter
   C. The Moon
   D. The Sun

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Compare the teachings of Parshvanath and Guru Ram Das Ji. (5 marks)

42. Explain what Maha Shivratri teaches. (4 marks)

43. Describe how Sikhs show respect to Guru Granth Sahib Ji in a gurdwara. (3 marks)

44. Explain why respect for a Mandir is important and how a visitor of any faith can show it. (5 marks)

45. Give two safety rules for yoga. (2 marks)

46. Write three ways in which a child can practise Prani Daya. (3 marks)

47. State three reasons why the Saraswati Vandana is said by students. (3 marks)

48. Explain the meaning of Kapaal Bhaati. (3 marks)

49. Who compiled Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji first, and who declared it the eternal Guru? (2 marks)

50. Describe how a child can follow all five principles in one day. (5 marks)

51. Why should we not pollute rivers? (2 marks)

52. Explain how a school can make festivals inclusive. (4 marks)

53. Why is water sometimes used in worship? Give three points. (3 marks)

54. Describe the four things a person may do at a Mandir and what each shows. (4 marks)

55. Describe three rites and rituals in a Mandir. (3 marks)

56. Describe how to pray well. (4 marks)

57. Match the days to the planets: Budhvaar, Guruvaar, Shukravaar. (3 marks)

58. What is Pranayam? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Jainism
   Jains believe Lord Mahavir became enlightened on its bank.

2. C — Bodhi tree
   The Bodhi tree is a kind of fig tree, also called the peepal.

3. C — Water from the River Ganga
   Jal means water, so Ganga jal is water from the Ganga.

4. A — Tulsi
   Tulsi is the holy basil plant.

5. B — To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   Washing before prayer is a way of showing cleanliness and respect.

6. A — Satya, always speak the truth
   Satya means truthfulness.

7. A — He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   He helped the hurt bird.

8. D — The one who saves a life has more right to it
   They said saving life is a greater right.

9. C — Man and lion
   Nar means man and simha means lion.

10. C — Equality and serving others
   He taught that all people are equal and service is important.

11. B — At the doorway, neither inside nor outside
   Narsimha stopped him at the threshold.

12. B — Before meals and in the evening
   It is said before meals, at assembly and in the evening.

13. B — Music and the arts
   It is a musical instrument.

14. A — By humming or listening
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

15. B — A bell rung gently on arrival
   The bell announces arrival.

16. D — Ask permission
   Always ask first.

17. D — Wearing the seat belt
   A seat belt protects you.

18. A — Ksh 30
   100 minus 70 is 30.

19. C — They should be true, kind and helpful
   Right speech.

20. A — Return the extra to the shopkeeper
   Integrity means giving it back.

21. D — The breath out
   The breath is pushed out in short pulls.

22. C — Through the nose, slowly
   We breathe calmly through the nose.

23. B — It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   Yoga calms the body and mind.

24. A — They are active and need care
   They are active exercises.

25. A — Soul
   Atma is the soul.

26. C — A person who changes old clothes for new
   The body is like worn clothes.

27. D — An atma, a small part of the divine
   This is why Hindus respect all life.

28. A — Dharma
   Dharma is right living.

29. B — Prayer
   Prarthana is prayer.

30. C — The great night of Shiva
   Maha means great and ratri means night.

31. D — The national flag
   The flag is raised and the anthem sung.

32. D — Phalguna
   Phalguna, in February or March.

33. A — Om Namah Shivaya
   It is a well-known prayer to Shiva.

34. C — Self-control, faith and staying alert to do good
   These are its lessons.

35. A — A heavenly body
   Graha is a heavenly body.

36. A — Guruvaar
   Guru is Jupiter.

37. C — Making a rhyme or song
   Songs help us remember.

38. D — Mars
   Mars is the red planet.

39. C — The Moon and the Sun
   It is lunar and solar.

40. C — The Moon
   Som is the Moon.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Parshvanath taught Ahimsa, truth, not taking what is not given and not being greedy. Guru Ram Das Ji taught equality, honest work, humility and service. Both teach kindness and care for others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each teaching set and 1 mark for a comparison.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Self-control through fasting, faith through prayer, staying alert to do good, and thinking about our mistakes and trying to be better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is placed on a raised seat; people cover their heads, remove shoes and bow before it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: A Mandir is a holy place. Visitors can remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, ask before photos and accept prasad politely. Respect brings peace among faiths.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for holy place, 3 marks for three ways, 1 mark for peace.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practise with a teacher, wear loose clothes, do it on a mat, do not do it after a big meal, stop if you feel dizzy (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give water to thirsty animals, share food, help a hurt friend, do not harm insects, care for plants (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: To ask for a clear mind, good speech and love for reading, music and the arts (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kapaal means forehead and bhaati means shining, so it means shining forehead. The breath goes out in short pushes and breathing in happens by itself.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for meaning, quick breath out and automatic breath in.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Arjan Dev Ji compiled it; Guru Gobind Singh Ji declared it the Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: Morning prayer and Namaste (Prarthana, Paramatma), honest schoolwork (Dharma, Artha), helping a friend (Prani Daya), thinking about the day's good deeds (Punarjanam and karma).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each principle applied, up to 5.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Polluted rivers harm plants, animals and people who use the water, and take away the sacredness of the water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Give clear instructions, help learners with special needs to take part, share food and clothes with the needy, and invite all faiths and communities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: It cleans, so it is a sign of purity; it is used to wash the hands and feet before prayer; it is poured or sprinkled to show a place is clean and ready.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Darshan shows respect, aarti offers light, prasad shows blessing and sharing, bhajans show love in song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Darshan, aarti, prasad, bhajans, ringing the bell (any three, with a short description).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly, fold hands, think of God with love, say thanks, ask for wisdom and kindness, and end with a promise to do good (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mercury, Jupiter, Venus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathing exercises.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for breathing practice.
